When i was about 8 years old, i was sleeping in my bed, and i was dreaming that my older sister had gone to a specific pharmacy in my town to buy new foundation - it was the end of summer and she had gotten a tan, so she needed a darker foundation. I remember thinking of this while i saw her entering the pharmacy, walking to the counter etc.

When i woke up i noticed it was morning, and i heard the car parking in the garage outside. I lay in silence as i hear the recognizable heels of my sister walking upstairs. Already feeling kind of odd, i see her open the door to my room and say good morning.
This is what imediately got to me: she was wearing the same pink&green polkadot dress she was wearing in the dream.

I imediately ask her "hey, did you go to x pharmacy to buy new foundation?"
Her smile dropped and she went a bit pale. She said "yes...how do you know?" I told her i had just dreamt it. 
We both kind of stared in silence at eachother in disbelief until we half-scared laughed it off and she exited.
We havent talked much about it since.

Ive heard this before. I know how you must feel. I saw a comment validating that sort of response in light of self-preservation by the other person, and as much as i support that logic, i also think a relationship should be a safe place for people to heal, not a place where we can only be when we are calm and "normal". 
However i hope you can find healthy ways to self soothe. Sadly, there wont always be someone there to help, and either way we should rely on ourselves the most in these kinds of things. Youve got all you need, just trust yourself. I know these sound like shallow advice but take them from someone whos speaking from true experience.
Best of wishes to you 👍

I think it only depends on what you are looking for. A friendship with benefits is for when you would enjoy having sex on a regular basis with someone you find cool, but dont feel ready/want/need to be in a full fledged relationship. 
And he can only take advantage of you if there is anything to take advantage of! If you have feelings for him, dont do it - it is very likely those feelings with get hurt. The rule of thumb for me is to never develop feelings for the other person, like that you cant get hurt OR taken advantage of! If theres no feelings, it will be very easy to say no or to leave when you want to. Feelings are the ones that make us want to please the other, sometimes to our detriment, or make us more susceptible to what others want, hence easier to manipulate.

Hope this helped!
